rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when people or objects are made to form a line.

example.english: The students align in a line before entering the hall.
example.traditional: 啲學生入禮堂前排成一行。
example.jyutping: di1 hok6 saang1 jap6 lai5 tong4 cin4 paai4 sing4 jat1 hong4

rows.note: Use this for identifying with or supporting another person’s, group’s, or country’s views and behaviour.

example.english: I really align with his views on education.
example.traditional: 我好認同佢對教育嘅睇法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jing6 tung4 keoi5 deoi3 gaau3 juk6 ge3 tai2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when aligning things means making their format, method, or organization consistent.

example.english: The company wants to align the report formats across all departments.
example.traditional: 公司想統一各部門嘅報表格式。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 soeng2 tung2 jat1 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 bou3 biu2 gaak3 sik1
